## HL · MCP (internal)
Lesson 4.6. n8n as an MCP server: path orders, Bearer auth, two read-only Call n8n Workflow tools.

**Credentials:** Bearer Auth credential holding a long random token (select it in the MCP Server Trigger).
**Replace:** YOUR_ORDER_STATUS_WORKFLOW_ID (pick SUB · Order status); YOUR_TODAY_SUMMARY_WORKFLOW_ID (pick SUB · Today summary).

Publish (activate) the workflow and copy the PRODUCTION URL, not the test URL.

parameters.name: get_order_status
parameters.description: Returns the status, items, total, delivery date and rider for one Harvest Lane order. Use when asked about a specific order. Input order_id, format HL-0000, e.g. HL-0042.

parameters.name: get_today_summary
parameters.description: Returns today's order count, revenue in naira, pending orders and low-stock items. Use for "how did today go?" questions. No input.
